description: PowerShell is a shell and scripting language. Its pipelines can carry objects with named properties. These 12 starter lessons use small examples and simple words. Read the result, make one small change, and try the practice question. Open PowerShell 7. Paste one example or save it as lesson.ps1 and run pwsh -NoProfile -File lesson.ps1. No administrator access is needed.
whatYouWillLearn: Read a named key with PowerShell
learningObjectives: Read an array item with PowerShell
